correctness.rationale: The product Ry objective is multi-affine in z_i=cosθ_i; a nonvertex stationary coordinate has local coefficient zero and is flat, preventing a strict minimum. At vertices Hessian is diagonal, with positive entries exactly when each triangle has one negative spin given 0<ε<h1<h2<h3<2−ε; every other pattern has a negative entry. Hence precisely 3^m nondegenerate strict minima with uniform eigenvalue interval [min(h1−ε,2−h3−ε),max(h3+ε,2−h1+ε)]. Replacing a nonpreferred minus by a negative a spin saves ≥2(h2−h1−2ε), proving unique ground minimum and gap. Uniform-angle trigonometric moments give mean normalized gradient square 1/2+(h1²+h2²+h3²)/6+(m−1)ε²/(6m). Independent exact rational enumeration for m=1,2,3,4 reproduced 3,9,27,81 strict minima, unique ground and min gap 1/5 in test instance; universal proof is local analytic.
